data.reason: Original University of Plymouth journal article listing, Abstract section, was accessed on 2026-11-10; it describes non-anaesthetist participants comparing learnability of three eight-alarm sets across ten trial blocks. That ABSTRACT supports the prior title/abstract include-to-full-text decision, but no original Elsevier article Methods, Results, stimuli, participant identity, effect sizes or full-paper text was accessed. Direct ScienceDirect article route was disabled to this tool, not demonstrated unavailable to all readers. Under frozen §6.2(3) and §6.3 this report must remain awaiting_text until lawful original text is actually inspected. The three sets are three experimental conditions, not independent studies or samples; no full-text E1-E6 decision or Track E admission is inferred.
